svg.title: High overlap can conceal a broken connection
svg.desc: Original two-reservoir binary geometry connected by a two-row bridge. Removing four pixels cuts the connection while Dice remains above 0.99 and area loss is below one percent. Component count uses four-neighbor connectivity. These masks are a topology example, not a solved cardiac-flow model.
